name: Alphenal
summary: Alphenal, also known as 5-allyl-5-phenylbarbituric acid, is a barbiturate derivative developed in the 1920s. It has primarily anticonvulsant properties and was used occasionally for the treatment of epilepsy or convulsions, although not as commonly as better known barbiturates such as phenobarbital.

summaryZh: 苯烯比妥（英語：Phenallylmal或Alphenal），又名5-苯基-5-烯丙基巴比妥酸，是1920年代開發的巴比妥類衍生物。它主要具有抗驚厥作用，偶爾用於治療癲癇或驚厥，但它的使用不像其它巴比妥類藥物（如苯巴比妥）那樣普遍。
